position_statement_zh: 本方案明确采取非中立立场：优先保障老年、残障、儿童与低数字技能群体的无障碍取件权与安全通行权，而非最大化机器人运营效率。
position_statement_en: This proposal explicitly takes a non-neutral position: it prioritizes the barrier-free pickup and safe passage rights of elderly, disabled, children and low-digital-skill groups over robot operational efficiency maximization.

affected_groups.concern_zh: 数字技能不足、取件难、药品配送依赖
无障碍通道、代取代办、驿站坡道
上学通勤安全、机器人速度恐惧

affected_groups.name_zh: 低数字技能低收入居民
affected_groups.concern_zh: 无 App 服务路径、费用负担
夜间安全、照明、配送时段
职业替代风险、转型培训

no_app_service_requirement: Every scenario must offer a non-digital path (phone, paper, in-person) that delivers the same core service without an app, account or device.
fairness_ledger_note_zh: 公开报告各群体体验差异（送达时长/投诉率/无障碍可达率），不用平均值掩盖最弱群体体验。
fairness_ledger_note_en: Publicly report experience differences across groups (delivery time/complaint rate/accessibility rate); never mask weakest-group experience with averages.
field_baselines: All group baselines are unknown until authorized surveys are conducted; this is not omission but explicit data-gap disclosure.
